headline: One banknote.
One very quiet city.
support: Base City went quiet. The builders moved on, the streets emptied, and the lights in the towers went out one by one.

Then a single banknote walked in: Cashy, the Base Note, denomination 8453, the chain ID of Base itself. He isn’t here to be spent. He’s here to rebuild. Every $CASHY trade runs on Feel.cash, in a pool paired with MSTR, Strategy’s stock, and 0.85% of every trade goes back to holders, paid in MSTR stock, about once a day. Each payout is a Payday, and each Payday turns another light back on in Base City.
As more Base projects move in, they get their own building, and their characters take over the streets. One block at a time, the quiet city becomes the Base Renaissance.

skyline.label: A neon city skyline at night under a blue moon. Cashy, a banknote in sunglasses and a leather jacket, stands on a rooftop ledge with his arms crossed.
